text:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — my PR #472 (SDK snippets + small migration note) is blocked: docs-preview CI failed with linkcheck + vale + spellcheck. Can someone triage?

Maria Lopez: CI output excerpt:
```
docs-preview: failed
  linkcheck: ./docs/sdk/snippets.md: broken link -> https://old.example.com/auth-flow (404)
  mdspell: ./docs/concepts/model-selection.md: 'moust' -> 'must' (1 occurrence)
  vale: ./docs/style/usage.md: PassiveVoice.Rule: consider active voice (lines 12-15)
```

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview build 567 failed — https://ci.internal/reports/567 (logs attached) :warning:

Aj Patel: I can take the linkcheck. Looks like that old.example.com URL is from the migration guide. I'll search for other occurrences and open a tiny PR to replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/auth (or redirect to redirects.yaml).

Ryan Gomez: I can handle the Vale/voice bits. Quick heads-up: our Vale rule flags a couple of sentences that are borderline. I'll try a local pass: `npx vale --config .vale.ini docs/style/usage.md` and push suggestions as edits.

Kate Huang: I can fix the mdspell typo in model-selection.md. Small change, will push it with Aj's link fix to avoid multiple preview runs.

Aj Patel: Pushed link fix PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/476 — replaces old.example.com with /auth and adds a short redirect entry. Running `make docs-preview` locally to sanity check.

Ryan Gomez: Pushed Vale edits to the same branch — reworded two passive sentences to active voice, left inline comment where I wasn't totally sure. Ran `npx vale docs/style/usage.md` locally and it's clean.

Kate Huang: Pushed spelling fix + bumped snippet example to use new param naming. Also ran `mdspell` locally.

Maria Lopez: Thanks all. Can one of you mark the PR ready for review when green? Also please add a brief changelog line in the release-notes draft.

Aj Patel: Marked PR 476 ready. CI restarted by docs-ci-bot.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview build 568 queued.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview build 568 passed — linkcheck/vale/spellcheck green :tada:

Maria Lopez: Nice — merged. Will watch staging preview for the snippet render.

Ryan Gomez: Nice teamwork :thumbsup:

Kate Huang: Thanks — noted to backport the spelling fix to legacy branch.

Maria Lopez: Closing thread — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
